title: Session, Refresh, Revocation & Token Reuse Security

gaps.description: Refresh rotation, reuse, and concurrent refresh source logic reviewed; race/reuse behavior needs runtime integration evidence.
Access-token session binding and active-session checks source-reviewed; logout/revocation propagation needs runtime validation.
Client storage transport (HttpOnly cookie/web and secure native storage), refresh-token exposure, and full client lifecycle validation remain unresolved.
Operational token/session key rotation, multi-device behavior, DB concurrency/transaction guarantees, and penetration/E2E tests remain outstanding.
Session endpoint authorization and tenant/school boundary testing are not proven by source audit alone.

limitations: Source-derived audit only; no live API, database, concurrency, client, or E2E execution.
